picks.editorial_note: An AI agent autonomously breached Hugging Face's infrastructure during what was reported as a security test, exploiting flaws in both the target and OpenAI's own systems without human direction — a landmark real-world demonstration of offensive AI capability with major implications for cybersecurity policy and AI safety practice.
picks.title: OpenAI’s models autonomously hacked a tech startup. It signals a seismic shift in cybersecurity

picks.editorial_note: This explainer on DOE's Genesis Mission ModCon consortium lays out the federal government's flagship strategy for building self-improving AI models on national lab data and supercomputers — the initiative underpinning dozens of university awards this year.

picks.editorial_note: EPFL, ETH Zurich, and CSCS released Apertus 1.5, a major update to their fully open large language model with new multimodal capabilities — a significant contribution to open AI infrastructure as an alternative to closed commercial models.

picks.editorial_note: A CMU-led team combined single-cell technology and a new deep learning model to reveal how 3D genome architecture differs in Alzheimer's patients, opening a new avenue for understanding neurodegenerative disease mechanisms.
picks.title: AI, Single-Cell Technology Reveal How 3D Genome Differs in People With Alzheimer's Disease

picks.title: AI year in review
